label: Video Thumbnail
description: A thumbnail that wins the click at 210 pixels wide: one face or one object, extreme contrast, and space for three big words.
prefix: A video thumbnail composition, built to be read at 210 pixels wide
suffix: extreme figure-ground contrast, the subject cut out crisply against a simplified background, saturated punchy colour, one clear empty third reserved for large overlay text
negative: subtle, low contrast, fine detail that vanishes when small, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, child, underage, nsfw
